crossword.name: Crossword AI
crossword.tagline: Fresh AI crosswords and scanwords, never a repeat.

millionaire.name: Millionaire AI

hangman.tagline: The classic word game, in Armenian.

items.title: Free to use
items.body: Every app is free, with no account and no paywall standing between you and playing.

items.title: Written for your language
items.body: Content is written natively for each language rather than translated word for word — and Armenian and Russian are first-class, not an afterthought.

items.title: Any device, even offline
items.body: Phone, tablet or desktop. The games install like apps from the browser and keep working without a connection.

items.question: What is eapps?
items.answer: eapps (eapps.site) is a small marketplace of free web apps and games: Crossword AI, Millionaire AI and Armenian Hangman. Each one is a standalone app; this page lists them in one place.

items.question: Are the apps free?
items.answer: Yes. Every app is completely free and needs no sign-up.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. Every app runs in a modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer. You can also add any of them to your home screen as an installable web app.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: This site is in English, Russian and Armenian. Crossword AI plays in all three, Millionaire AI in 80 languages, and Hangman in Armenian.

items.question: Do the apps work offline?
items.answer: Yes: once you have opened them, the games keep working without a connection, using what they have already saved. Fresh AI content arrives when you are back online.

items.question: Who makes eapps?
items.answer: eapps is built and run by Michael Navasardyan, an independent developer. Each app has its own page with its rules, privacy policy and contact details.
